configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.description: Debug + Release from one tree needs a multi-config generator; the environment-dependent default (plain Ninja) would silently ignore --config and ship a Debug-only artifact

configurePresets.name: ios
configurePresets.description: Same flags MsQuic's own build uses for ios (PLATFORM=OS64: device arm64). The toolchain file is MsQuic's vendored ios.cmake, downloaded by scripts/build.ps1 before configure

configurePresets.name: android
configurePresets.description: Needs ANDROID_NDK_HOME set and the NDK's llvm bin dir on PATH (MsQuic's OpenSSL configure reads both). android-29 matches the API floor MsQuic hardcodes into its OpenSSL build. Other ABIs: -DANDROID_ABI=... -B build-android-<abi>
